claim_to_falsify: A 2-component action-conditioned linear dynamical memory, learned without world_sign labels solely from prior executed actions and their observed effects, can identify the new active mechanism with ONE executed informative probe and choose better subsequent goal-directed actions than equally probing a single-regime ridge model, passive two-regime mixture, and fixed action policy, with exact cold restore. This is a toy conventional CONTROL, not Hybrid improvement or external science.

world.type: deterministic author-mathematical family of F8-R3; no original CartPoleWind source
world.fit_policy: step0: opposite sign-feedback policy; later: deterministic exploring 0 or 1 using seed and t, without hidden sign
world.fit_hidden_sign_balanced: sign determined by world index parity for SOURCE ONLY and withheld from learner
world.score_intervention_budget_per_policy: one factual probe followed by one factual chosen action; no access to unchosen effects before action

models.two_expert: per-world ridge fit from 12 observed (s,a,y) effects using X=(s,a-behavior(s)); learn two clusters by sorting fitted action coefficient, 12 worlds each; cluster means provide two trained experts; never use world sign label
models.single_expert: one pooled ridge fit on all same fit worlds, no world label or posterior
models.two_expert_passive: same learned two experts and same one probe budget, but probe uses logged behavior action at state0.2
models.fixed_action0: same probe budget but always choose 0 for subsequent goal action
models.oracle: post-choice evaluator-only best of two realized effects; never used for model fitting, probing, or choosing
models.coefficient_order: sort per-world action coefficient ascending, first12 low, last12 high

metrics.primary: paired mean goal-squared regret vs oracle on two signs x 48 fixed state-goal pairs
secondary: exact JSON cold restored coefficients and belief
metrics.precommitted_dev_pass: trained active two-expert regret <=0.1 * single_expert regret AND <=0.1 * two_expert_passive regret AND <=0.1 * fixed_action0 regret, with nonzero regrets for all three controls, AND postprobe expert identification 96/96, AND wrong-credit shuffle weakens fit by >= 5x, AND cold restore exact

limitations: An author-synthetic toy on a known two-sign linear world cannot establish transferable learning, actual environmental intervention success, general intelligence, autonomous RSI or improvement of original Hybrid neural architecture. Retain failures or unexpected negative outcomes.
